applies_why: The judge declares UNDERDETERMINED because the same verse was given two readings, covenant presence versus physical source in the womb, which is the single-verse ambiguity K-S2 removes from the grounds for UNDERDETERMINED.
quote: UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the conception agency as covenant presence in [DR3] and defender answered the physical source in the womb in [CR2] and [CR3].
rule_words: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. When one verse's words carry two meanings at once, both stand; the verse is not open.
room: Phrase: When one verse's words carry two meanings at once, both stand; the verse is not open. Readings weighed: both meanings must stand so the verse is not open vs. divergent party readings of the same verse can make it UNDERDETERMINED.
why: The judge's UNDERDETERMINED label rests on the two answers to Matthew 1:20 instead of treating both meanings as standing, so it breaches K-S2.
